verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official CLI with 50+ commands covering subscribers, CSV import, tags, fields, events, broadcasts, sequences, transactional email and templates. Its Bento Skills guidance explicitly tells AI agents when to use the CLI versus MCP or an SDK, which ties the CLI to AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documentation of agent-oriented details such as install/auth flow and machine-readable output.
